team.note: Up to 3 animals can travel with you: a 2nd joins at level 10, a 3rd at level 20. Some pairs from the Bible work extra well together!

team.slot: Level {0}: a {1} animal friend can join your team! Open Animals to choose.
cb.title: Bible pairs
cb.hidden: Find both animals to learn what this pair can do.
cb.peace.d: “The wolf will live with the lamb” (Isaiah 11:6). Heals you a little every turn.
cb.lionlamb.d: Jesus is called both the Lion of Judah and the Lamb (Revelation 5:5–6). Stronger powers and a little healing.
cb.courage.d: “Bold as a lion” (Proverbs 28:1) and “wings like eagles” (Isaiah 40:31). Your powers hit harder.
cb.gentle.d: “The leopard will lie down with the young goat” (Isaiah 11:6). Your powers hit harder.
cb.manger.d: “The ox knows its owner, the donkey its master’s manger” (Isaiah 1:3). A shield blocks the first hits of every battle.
cb.ark.d: Noah sent out a raven and a dove (Genesis 8:7–8). +20% XP after battles.
cb.work.d: Go to the ant and be wise (Proverbs 6:6). +25% shekels after battles.
cb.jonah.d: A great fish swallowed Jonah (Jonah 1:17). All foes are washed back and miss their first turn.
cb.flock.d: “The LORD is my shepherd” (Psalm 23:1). Heals you a little every turn.
cb.stream.d: “As the deer pants for streams of water” (Psalm 42:1). Heals you every turn.
lf.101a: I count my sheep every evening. If one is missing, I go and look until I find it – just like the Good Shepherd!
lf.101b: My husband fishes on the lake all night. Some say Jesus once filled their nets so full they almost broke!
lf.102a: This is the river where John baptized people – and where Jesus was baptized too. The water is cold, but the people came from everywhere.
lf.102b: God is like a potter, and we are the clay (Isaiah 64:8). He shapes us with gentle hands.
lf.103a: David hid from King Saul in these hills. He could have hurt Saul in a cave, but he chose not to.
lf.103b: Out here it is quiet. Jesus went into the desert to pray. Sometimes being quiet is the best way to listen to God.
lf.104a: From this coast Jonah tried to sail away from God – the wrong way! It did not go well for him.
lf.104b: Peter stayed at a tanner’s house in Joppa. Up on the roof, God showed him that the good news is for everyone.
lf.105a: We sing the Psalms on the way up to the Temple: “I was glad when they said to me, let us go to the house of the LORD!”
lf.105b: Spices from far away! The wise men brought myrrh and frankincense to baby Jesus, you know.
lf.121a: I am the proconsul of Cyprus. I wanted to hear God’s word, and Paul and Barnabas came to teach me.
lf.121b: Barnabas grew up here on Cyprus! His name means “son of encouragement”.
lf.122a: Paul told us to wait for winter here. I wanted to sail on… I should have listened.
lf.122b: I am Julius. I must bring Paul to Rome. He is a prisoner, but he is the bravest man on this ship.
lf.123a: My father was very sick with fever. Paul prayed for him, put his hands on him, and he was healed!
lf.123b: We saw the ship break apart on the rocks. But all 276 people reached the shore safely!
lf.124a: Aquila and I made tents with Paul in Corinth. Now we are together again in Rome!
lf.124b: Paul writes letters to churches far away. Those letters are now in your Bible!
lf.130a: I keep watch from the top of this tower, day and night.
lf.130b: Every floor has a lamp. “Your word is a lamp to my feet” (Psalm 119:105).
wc.hedgehog.d: Curls into a prickly ball that can freeze a foe. Lives in the Galilee hills.
wc.horse.d: “Do you give the horse his strength?” (Job 39:19). Gallops in with a mighty kick.
wc.badger.d: “They make their homes in the rocks” (Proverbs 30:26). Comes out at night in the desert.
wc.dromedary.d: Rebekah watered the camels (Genesis 24:19). Carries home extra shekels.
wc.dolphin.d: Leaps through the waves and splashes every foe at once.
wc.seal.d: A gentle seal from the rocky shores of Cyprus. Big, cozy healing.
wc.crab.d: A hard shell held up like a shield. Lives in the harbors of Crete.
wc.octopus.d: Eight arms, eight hits! Found in the clear water around Malta.
wc.lizard.d: “The lizard is found in kings’ palaces” (Proverbs 30:28). Freezes foes with a quick stare.
x.towerLock: The Tower opens after you finish {0} worlds.
x.landLock: The road into the Land opens after the very last gate.
land.intro1: Well done, pilgrim! A road now leads from Pilgrim’s Rest out into the Land itself.
land.intro2: Bit by bit you can explore it all: the desert, the Jordan Valley, the hills around Jerusalem, the coast and Galilee. Each region opens after the stories that happen there.
land.intro3: Travellers need help every day. Wild animals hide in the hills, and caves hold old secrets.
land.intro4: Someone even found pieces of an old song scroll – a Psalm. Can you find all 12 pieces?
x.rainbowT: “I set my rainbow in the cloud” (Genesis 9:13). God keeps his promises. You feel fresh and strong!
sea.intro1: At the harbor a big wooden ship creaks in the waves. The sailors are getting ready.
sea.intro2: Paul sailed this sea many times: to Cyprus with Barnabas, and later past Crete and Malta all the way to Rome.
sea.intro3: Sail to the islands and help Paul and his friends. Watch out for storm clouds!
ps.moreP: More pages are hidden in the Land, in the caves and on the islands.
ps.allP: You found the whole Psalm! Read it again – it’s a song of trust.
ps.reward: The whole Psalm is found! +300 shekels, +200 XP and a golden trophy for your house.
ps.1: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
ps.2: He makes me lie down in green pastures.
ps.3: He leads me beside still waters.
ps.5: He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
ps.6: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
ps.7: I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
ps.8: Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
ps.9: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies.
ps.10: You anoint my head with oil; my cup runs over.
ps.11: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life,
ps.12: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
rq.merchant: Peace to you! I travel from town to town with my wares.
rq.shepherd: Hello, friend! I look after the flock out here.
rq.fisher: Shalom! I am on my way to the lake.
rq.widow: Oh, a kind face! I am so glad you came by.
rq.potter: Greetings! I make jars and bowls from clay.
rq.pilgrim: Peace! I am walking up to Jerusalem for the feast.
rq.scribe: Ah, a young learner! I copy the holy scrolls.
rq.vine: Welcome! Have you seen my vineyard? The grapes are almost ready.
rq.hi.find: Could you help me? I lost {0} {1} somewhere around here. Please bring them back!
rq.hi.hunt: Gloomlings keep blocking the road. Could you chase away {0} of them?
rq.hi.quiz: I love to talk about God’s word. Will you answer my questions? Get 2 of 3 right!
rq.hi.food: I have walked so far and I am very hungry. Do you have some food to share?
rq.noFood: Oh, your bag is empty. Lydia’s shop at Pilgrim’s Rest sells bread – come back if you get some!
rq.thanksFood: Thank you! “Whoever gives even a cup of water…” – Jesus said that kindness is never forgotten.
rq.thanks: Thank you so much! God bless you. Please take this.
rq.quizNo: Good try! Come and talk to me again whenever you are ready.
rq.again: Thank you again for your help! Tomorrow somebody else might need you.
wild.hi: A wild {0} {1} peeks out at you. It looks shy…
wild.how: Answer {0} questions right to earn its trust!
wild.yes: The {0} {1} trusts you now. It wants to come along!
wild.no: The {0} got scared and ran away. Try again tomorrow!
is.121.a1: Welcome to Cyprus! I’m Barnabas – I grew up on this island. Paul and I sailed here to share the good news.
is.121.a2: The proconsul, Sergius Paulus, wants to hear God’s word. But a sorcerer called Elymas keeps trying to stop him.
is.121.a3: Gloomlings of confusion are blocking the road to the palace. Please chase away 4 of them!
is.121.w1: Keep going! The road to the palace is still blocked.
is.121.b1: The road is clear! Paul spoke to the proconsul, and Elymas could not stop it.
is.121.b2: When Sergius Paulus saw what happened, he believed and was amazed at the teaching about the Lord (Acts 13:12).
is.121.d1: Barnabas means “son of encouragement”. I hope you feel encouraged today!
is.122.a1: This harbor is called Fair Havens. I warned the captain: “If we sail now, the trip will be dangerous” (Acts 27:10).
is.122.a2: Whatever they decide, the ship needs food. Please find 3 jars of grain that rolled away from the market!
is.122.w1: We still need more jars of grain for the long trip.
is.122.b1: Thank you! In the storm I will tell everyone: “Take heart! God told me that not one of you will be lost” (Acts 27:22).
is.122.d1: Trust God even when the waves are high.
is.123.a1: Our ship broke apart on the rocks – but everyone swam or floated to shore, just as God promised!
is.123.a2: The islanders were very kind and built a fire, because it was raining and cold (Acts 28:2). Please help me gather 4 bundles of sticks!
is.123.w1: We still need more sticks to keep the fire going.
is.123.b1: Thank you! When I put the sticks on the fire, a viper came out and bit my hand.
is.123.b2: I shook it off into the fire and was not hurt at all! God protected me. Then we prayed for the sick people of Malta, and they were healed.
is.123.d1: God took care of us on Malta. He will take care of you, too.
is.124.a1: Welcome to Rome! I am a prisoner here, but they let me live in my own rented house.
is.124.a2: Every day people come to visit, and I tell them about Jesus “with all boldness” (Acts 28:31).
is.124.a3: Will you help me teach my visitors? Answer 3 of 4 questions right!
is.124.w1: More visitors have come! Will you help me teach them?
is.124.no: Good try! Let’s try again soon.
is.124.b1: Well done! Even in chains, God’s word cannot be chained.
is.124.b2: From here I write letters to the churches – to Philippi, Ephesus, Colossae… Here, I found something for you.
is.124.d1: “I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me” (Philippians 4:13).
tw.title: Tower of the Watchman
tw.verse: “I will stand at my watch and station myself on the tower.”
tw.how: Climb as high as you can! Every floor has a battle and every 5th floor a boss. Every 7th floor is a day of rest. Your health carries over, so use your food wisely. Every 10 floors you reach a checkpoint.
tw.friends: Your highest floor is shown to your friends on the leaderboard.
tw.hi1: Welcome to the tower! I keep watch here, like the prophet Habakkuk.
tw.hi2: The stairs go up and up. How high can you climb?
tw.rest: You rest by a window: +{0} health.
tw.cpGot: Checkpoint {0} reached! +{1} shekels and a trophy for your house.
tw.endP: Rest, eat something and try again!

era.0.d: God makes the world, and keeps His promise to Noah.
era.1.d: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and Joseph trust God’s promises.
era.2.d: God rescues His people from Egypt and leads them through the wilderness.
era.3.d: Brave judges and faithful people in the land God gave.
era.4.d: Kings and prophets: David, Solomon, Elijah and Jonah.
era.5.d: Far from home, God’s people stay faithful – and come back to rebuild.
era.6.d: Jesus is born, teaches, heals, dies and rises again.
era.7.d: The Holy Spirit comes, and the good news goes out to the whole world.
x.hubQ: Explore the Land 🧭 or climb the Tower 🪜!
tn.lock: The New Quarter opens after the very last gate.
tn.intro1: Pilgrim’s Rest is growing! So many travellers come by now that we need more houses, a well and a bakery.
tn.intro2: Bring wood, stone, wool, fish and olive oil from the Land, the islands and the Tower.
tn.intro3: Start with the well – every town needs water. “Unless the LORD builds the house, they labor in vain who build it” (Psalm 127:1).
tn.drunk: Fresh water! Your health is full.
tn.d.well: Every town needs water. Build it first!
tn.d.bakery: Fresh bread for the road, baked every morning.
tn.d.workshop: A carpenter’s workshop – Jesus was a carpenter too (Mark 6:3).
tn.d.pen: Your other animal friends rest and play here.
tn.d.school: Learn and practice the Scriptures together.
tn.d.market: Buy and sell with travellers from far away.
tn.d.guest: “Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers” (Hebrews 13:2).
tn.d.lighthouse: A light for ships on the Great Sea.
tn.e.well.1: Drink at the well: full health any time.
tn.e.bakery.3: 2 breads and a honey cake every day.
tn.e.workshop.1: Craft stools, baskets, benches and tables for your house.
tn.e.workshop.2: Also shelves, chests, jars and lamps.
tn.e.workshop.3: Also beds, rugs and olive plants.
tn.e.pen.1: Animals not in your team get 10 XP every day.
tn.e.pen.2: Animals not in your team get 25 XP every day.
tn.e.pen.3: Animals not in your team get 50 XP every day.
tn.e.school.1: Practice gives 5 shekels per right answer.
tn.e.school.2: Practice gives 7 shekels per right answer.
tn.e.school.3: Practice gives 9 shekels per right answer.
tn.e.market.1: Sell resources, and one special deal every day.
tn.e.guest.1: Up to 2 travellers you helped move in and bring gifts every day.
tn.e.guest.2: Up to 4 travellers can live here.
tn.e.guest.3: Up to 6 travellers can live here.
tn.e.lighthouse.2: Even fewer storm clouds at sea.
tn.e.lighthouse.3: Hardly any storm clouds at sea.

tn.morningP: Here is what the New Quarter has for you today:
tn.penGot: {0} animals in the pen got {1} XP
vl.0: I’m so glad I settled here. Thank you for helping me on the road!
vl.1: Every morning I hear the bread baking. What a lovely smell!
vl.2: “How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!” (Psalm 133:1)
vl.3: I left a little gift for you by the notice board this morning.
vl.4: When I was lost on the road, you helped me. Now this is home.
vl.5: Have you seen the Tower? I get dizzy just looking up!
vl.6: My children love the animals in the pen.
vl.7: We pray for you every evening, little pilgrim.
tw.sabV: “On the seventh day God rested from all his work.”
tw.sabP: No battle here. Rest, breathe and get strong again!
